facts.claim: The main shaft depth increased by 15 feet since the last report.
facts.quote: A depth of 15 feet has been gained in the main shaft since last report.

facts.claim: There are still 45 feet to be excavated before reaching the 225-foot level.
facts.quote: A distance of 45 feet yet to be run before reaching the 225 foot level.

facts.claim: The rock on the east side of the shaft is becoming softer and appears to be approaching a ledge.
facts.quote: The rock on east side of shaft is getting softer and has the appearance of approaching a ledge.
